title: Site office memo, 10 June 1998
text:
TO: All site staff
FROM: Site Supervisor

Slab pour for floors 5–8 will continue through the night of 13/14 June.
Overtime is compulsory. Anyone leaving early will not be paid for the week.

Personal belongings are to be kept in your lockers, NOT on the desks.

title: Note taped inside a drawer
text:
Mahadev never wrote his name on anything. Said his daughter's photo didn't need one.

If you can't read a name, try looking at it the way a camera does.
